title: The Feeling When: The Art of Anticipation
summary: Meet the four gay creative directors bringing Grindr Edge's The Feeling When campaign to life through stories of desire, anticipation, and connection.
body_markdown:
You know *that* feeling? The nervous excitement of meeting someone new. The butterflies before a first kiss. The anticipation of a hookup you've been thinking about all day. It's the delicious tension of not knowing exactly what's about to happen, but hoping it'll be good.


*The Feeling When* is a new creative campaign celebrating[Edge](http://edge.grindr.com/?utm_source=press&utm_medium=pr&utm_campaign=edge_register&utm_content=release) , Grindr's new premium subscription experience designed to help you get to the good part faster. More opportunities to connect mean more butterflies, more anticipation, and more of the moments that make meeting someone new so exciting.


To bring that feeling to life, we teamed up with four creative directors from across the Global Gayborhood to explore the excitement, desire, and anticipation that come before a real-life connection.


‍


##### [Jordi Terry](https://www.instagram.com/jorditerry/) **, Spain**


*The Feeling When: Someone Makes the Whole Room Disappear*


A packed dance floor. One look across the room. Then suddenly, you’re pulled close - and with one kiss, everything else disappears. The music, the crowd, the night… it’s just the two of you.


##### [Felipe Gomes](https://www.instagram.com/felipe_gms/) **, Brazil**


*The Feeling When: It's After Dark*


When the sun goes down, the possibilities heat up. Fleeting glances become invitations, touch becomes its own language, and the night is full of unexpected encounters. It's that electric feeling of not knowing where the night might take you.


##### [Patrick Linehan](https://www.instagram.com/patrickjlinehan/) **, USA**


*The Feeling When: The Best Part of the Night Happens After the Party*


The lights come up. The party’s over. But there’s still that look, that message, that one person you don’t quite want to say goodnight to yet. Sometimes the real night starts after everyone else has gone home.


##### [Jon Dean](https://www.instagram.com/jondeanallout/) **, UK**


*The Feeling When: He's 0 Meters Away*


You spot him across the bar. The eye contact is undeniable, but is he looking at you or through you? Then you open Grindr and there he is: zero metres away. Suddenly, the whole room feels charged, and making the first move feels inevitable.


‍


Four different perspectives, one shared feeling: the thrill of what happens next... Each director brings their own interpretation to the rush of anticipation that comes with meeting someone new.


And this is just the beginning. We'll be sharing more from these creatives as their films come to life, taking a closer look at the stories, sounds, and inspiration behind each interpretation of *The Feeling When* .


Sometimes the anticipation is half the fun. And with Edge, there's even more to look forward to.
